description: The exact SQLite archive has a verified teaching use case. On SQLite 3.40.1, the plain join and SUM(DISTINCT amount) each failed a different fictional regression case, and EXISTS passed all five. BrainStation teaches MySQL and its general contact form provides a route for an inquiry without establishing purchasing interest. Keep that inquiry with BUYER_ROUTE and test Ko-fi as a separate checkout option for the existing archive. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available but provides no new interpreted buyer signal and leaves five sources unclassified, so demand remains unknown.
